description: This PHP source file defines a test class 'LDAPTestConnectionAPITest' that extends 'EndpointTestCase' to perform unit testing of LDAP connection and configuration via API endpoints. It uses mocking and fixtures to simulate LDAP server interaction, testing LDAP connection creation, authentication, and search functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies LDAP connection and configuration API functionalities within OrangeHRM, including setup, mocking LDAP responses, and validating the create() API method for LDAP connection testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup method that skips the test if LDAP server is not configured, and loads the server configuration.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: A test method that constructs LDAP settings, mocks LDAP services, configures the API mock, invokes create(), and asserts that the LDAP connection test results match expected output.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper method that creates a mock EntryCollection with specified LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Helper method that generates LDAP Entry objects from a list of usernames for testing purposes.
